title: Apple to Debut Apple Intelligence in China Using Alibaba's Qianwen Model

tickers.name: Alibaba Group Holding Limited American Depositary Shares, each represents eight Ordinary Shares

summary:
Mainland users of iPhone will gain access to a localized version of Apple's generative AI suite starting with a developer beta on Nov. 4. The official public release is scheduled for December as part of the iOS 27.3 update, featuring a partnership with Alibaba to power the system. Chinese users will be able to access Alibaba's Qianwen model for text and image understanding and content generation through Siri, visual intelligence, and system-wide writing tools without leaving their Apple applications.

The launch comes after more than two years of delays since Apple first introduced the technology in 2024. While the integration provides core AI capabilities, certain advanced features debuted at WWDC 2026—such as cross-app operations and personal context understanding for Siri—will not be included in the initial Chinese release. Users can activate the service using their existing Apple IDs.

selectedTweets.text:
等了两年多，国行Apple Intelligence终于确定上线了！！！

今天，苹果正式官宣了Apple Intelligence的国行版，并宣布与阿里巴巴合作。

11月4日开始开发者Beta测试，12月随iOS 27.3正式上线。

在Siri中，用户可以直接调用千问回答问题，也可以把照片、PDF、演示文稿等内容交给千问理解；在系统级写作工具中，用户可以使用Compose with Qwen生成文字和图像；在视觉智能中，还可以直接通过摄像头向千问提问。

而且用户可以通过Apple登录直接使用千问，调用时无需跳转到独立App。

这意味着，千问将进入iPhone的原神使用场景，成为用户在Siri、写作工具和视觉智能中可以直接调用的模型。

不过，也有一个比较遗憾的地方。

这次上线的依然主要是第一代Apple Intelligence功能，苹果在WWDC 2026上发布的全新Siri AI，包括个人情境理解和跨App操作等能力，暂时还没有进入国行。

从2024年发布Apple Intelligence，到现在终于确定中国市场的上线时间，苹果这一步走了两年多。

对阿里来说，能够进入苹果这样的系统级入口，显然是千问商业化和生态布局上的重要进展。

用户还会有等了两年多，国行Apple Intelligence终于确定上线了。
